Schedule one appointment across several local calendars

Book appointments across time zones on Shopify →

Worked example

On March 15, 2026, 09:00 in New York is 14:00 in Paris. Two weeks later, on March 29, the same 09:00 New York appointment is 15:00 in Paris. The dates matter because the two regions move to daylight saving on different Sundays.

Time Zone Converter FAQ

Why should I choose a city instead of subtracting a fixed number of hours?

A city’s offset depends on the date and its local clock rules. Choosing the city lets the converter apply those rules for the actual appointment.

Can the same meeting fall on two different dates?

Yes. On January 15, 2027, a 17:00 appointment in Los Angeles begins at 10:00 on January 16 in Tokyo. Include the date as well as the time when sending the confirmation.

What happens when clocks move back and the local time occurs twice?

The converter lets you choose which occurrence you mean when the reference city repeats a time. Check the resulting UTC offset and the other cities before copying the meeting.

Why does a local time sometimes produce no result?

When clocks jump forward, some local times never occur on that date. Move the appointment to a valid time and compare the cities again.

Can I share the exact cities and time I chose?

Use the share-link option. The URL carries the cities and selected meeting details so another person can open the same comparison.

How do I add the meeting to my own calendar?

Set the meeting duration and download the calendar file. Open the ICS file in your calendar app and check the displayed date and start time before saving.
